snippet.title: Schreckenstein for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---



Game description:

Schreckenstein is a platform game for 1 or 2 players. If the player chooses 1 player the AI will take the place of the 2nd player.

The goal is to activate signs with a "L" on it. You can only activate them by collecting certain items, that kinda look like hammers. 

Eventually keys will pop up, which will lead to an exit...which the players have to find first.

Ghosts, bats, and traps will confuse the players if hit.


What I think:

Quite fun, most likely better with a 2nd player. 

However, I friggin' hate the traps! I love it to run around and forget about them...always happens. -_-'
